additions.reason: The text explicitly states 'וְהוּא בְּחִינַת אֵם הַבָּנִים' when describing the דיבור/שכינה. The Shekhinah/Malkhut is identified as 'mother of the children' because it accompanies Israel everywhere, just as a mother follows her children wherever they go ('כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָאֵם הוֹלֶכֶת תָּמִיד עִם בָּנֶיהָ'). This is a direct bechina equation of שכינה/דבור with the Mother archetype. The node belongs to Package 1 (מלכות ושכינה) as another face of the same divine presence.
additions.source_quote: וְהוּא בְּחִינַת אֵם הַבָּנִים, הַיְנוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָאֵם הוֹלֶכֶת תָּמִיד עִם בָּנֶיהָ

additions.reason: The text says 'וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת גָּלוּת הַשְּׁכִינָה, שֶׁהַדִּבּוּר שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַשְּׁכִינָה, בַּגָּלוּת, וְנִתְאַלֵּם.' The exile of the Shekhinah is explicitly named as a בחינה — it is the state in which the divine speech/Malkhut falls silent. While it belongs thematically to Package 1 (it is the negative state of מלכות/שכינה), its polarity is evil/fallen, making it the dark face of the same cluster. It could alternatively be assigned to Package 3 (defiled places), since the text links the silencing of speech with dwelling in defiled places. Recommended assignment: Package 3, as it represents the evil/exile dimension of the divine presence.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת גָּלוּת הַשְּׁכִינָה, שֶׁהַדִּבּוּר שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַשְּׁכִינָה, בַּגָּלוּת, וְנִתְאַלֵּם

additions.reason: The text says 'כָּבוֹד זוֹ שְׁכִינָה, כַּנּוֹדַע' — Glory is Shekhinah, as is well known. The verse 'וְנִגְלָה כְּבוֹד ה'' is interpreted as the revelation and growth of the light of the Shekhinah/Malkhut. This is a standard bechina equation in Kabbalistic language (כבוד = שכינה). It belongs to Package 1.
